description: Service booking platform connecting users with providers. Industry brain defines what is being booked. This core defines how booking works.

three_js.description: Soft glowing orbs of varying sizes drifting slowly. Calm, approachable. Orbs pulse gently. No hard geometry.
three_js.avoid: no status pills, no hero-stat-line, no ticker strips

relationships: User books an Appointment for a Service with a Provider
Appointment has a Status (pending, confirmed, completed, cancelled, no-show)
User writes a Review about a Provider or Service after Appointment
User can join a WaitList for a fully booked Service or time slot
Package belongs to Provider, bundles multiple Services
Notification belongs to User, triggered by Appointment status changes

layout.notes: Calendar and time slot picker are the most critical UI elements — they must be flawless on all form factors. Never paginate time slots — always show as scrollable chip grid.

avoid: Never use a date picker modal — always use an inline calendar on the booking screen
Never show fully booked providers in primary results without a 'next available' label
Never collect payment details before booking is confirmed
Never use ambiguous time formats — always show AM/PM or 24h consistently throughout
Never show a provider's personal phone number or email on their public profile
Never auto-select a time slot — user must always explicitly tap to select
Never show more than 2 service options above the fold on provider detail
Never use a rating below 3 stars without a review count — it misleads without context
enforce: Available time slots always shown as tappable chips — not a dropdown
Booked slots greyed and non-tappable — never hidden
Booking confirmation must show: date, time, provider, service, price — all on one screen before final confirm
Cancellation policy always visible on booking confirmation screen
5-second undo window immediately after booking confirmed — not a modal, a toast with countdown
Automated reminder shown as part of confirmation: 'We'll remind you 24h before'
Provider response time shown on their profile — 'Usually responds in 2 hours'
No-show policy displayed at booking — never hidden in settings

empty_states.ui: Location permission prompt — explain why: 'To show providers near you'. Single CTA: 'Enable location'. Secondary: 'Enter location manually'.
Calendar illustration. Message: 'No appointments yet'. CTA: 'Find a provider'. Do not show empty calendar grid.

empty_states.trigger: Provider has no availability this week
empty_states.ui: Calendar shows greyed week. Message: 'No availability this week'. Show next available date. CTA: 'See next available slot'.

loading_states.ui: Skeleton provider cards — circular avatar placeholder, name 2 lines, rating bar, distance chip. Shimmer animation.
Calendar loads immediately from cache. Time slots show skeleton chips while loading — same chip size as real slots.
Spinner on confirm button only. Summary visible and readable during load. Never block the summary with a full-screen loader.

error_flows.trigger: Selected time slot taken by another user
error_flows.ui: Full-screen modal: 'Sorry, that slot was just booked'. Show next 3 available slots inline. One-tap re-select. No form refill required.
Push notification + in-app alert. Full explanation screen: provider name, original time, reason if provided. Options: rebook same provider, find alternative, get refund.
Stay on booking screen. Red inline error on payment field. Slot held for 5 minutes — timer shown. Message: 'Slot held for 5:00. Update payment to confirm.'
Manual entry field appears immediately. No error state — seamless fallback. Map-based search replaced with text search.

edge_cases.ui: Toggle on booking form: 'Booking for myself / Someone else'. If someone else — name and contact field appears. Confirmation sent to both.
Calendar shows holiday marker. Tapping shows: 'Provider unavailable — public holiday'. Next available date highlighted.
Warning shown before confirm: 'This booking is within the [X]h cancellation window. Cancellation will incur a fee.' Explicit acknowledgement required.
Services stack on booking summary. Total time and total price calculated and shown. Never let stacked services exceed provider's working hours.
